change_summary: Route all generation calls to gpt-4.1-mini instead of passing through the configured model.
reason_for_change: Token I/O dominates cost and gpt-4.1-mini is ~5x cheaper. Transcripts show routine tool-driven lookup/confirm/execute flows (find_user, get_order_details, get_product_details, then a confirmed mutation) that don't need frontier reasoning, so routing every call to the cheaper model should slash mean cost per task while holding success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.5000 < floor 0.7283
hypothesis: Routing most/all generation calls to gpt-4.1-mini (the ~5x cheaper sibling) will cut per-task cost dramatically while holding success, because the observed tasks are mechanical lookup/confirm/execute flows (verify identity, fetch orders, match variants, confirm, call tool) that do not require frontier reasoning.
